grid: LOLA LDEM_75S_240M polar stereographic (pixel 240 m, pole at pixel 1905.5). level 0: 2.88 km cells lat<=-84; level 1: 0.96 km cells lat<=-88.5. i=row offset, j=col offset from pole, in cells.
method: Sun and Earth centres (point sources) vs terrain horizon from LOLA LDEM_75S_240M (bilinear heights, observer 2 m above ground, rays to 150 km). Grid cells: 64 azimuths; named pins: 360 azimuths. Earth direction is topocentric (parallax applied). Stats here = full year from 14 Nov 2026; the app recomputes for whatever window you choose.
uncertainty: Illumination is very local on ridges: a grid value is for its cell centre only (2.88 km cells, 0.96 km near the pole). Use named pins for exact points. Validated against Mazarico 2011 / Glaser 2018 20-yr values within 1-12 points on 4 points (worst: Connecting Ridge C1 vs Mazarico, -12 points; v2 failed the 2 m Gläser case by 26 points, fixed in v3 by bilinear observer heights); see data/validation_v3.json. Earth visibility is not validated against literature.
fields_note: lat/lon of a cell centre: polar stereographic pixel s = 1905.5 + j*cell_px, l = 1905.5 + i*cell_px (240 m px), see grid text
